title: Retrieve to Act: Motion Primitive Graph Retrieval for Robust VLA Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.37215v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies demonstrate remarkable semantic generalization, yet remain highly vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) visual shifts during execution. While existing test-time methods attempt to suppress spurious visual cues, they fundamentally overlook the rich, uncorrupted kinematic priors embedded in the policy's own training experience. We introduce Retrieve to Act (R2A), a test-time scaling framework that formulates OOD robustness purely as a geometric motion primitive retrieval problem. R2A bypasses fragile visual features by structuring successful training demonstrations into an offline spatiotemporal motion primitive graph. During inference, a query-dependent Graph Neural Network dynamically localizes the robot's ongoing execution within this graph, retrieving structurally compatible future motion primitives. These retrieved geometric priors are then seamlessly harmonized with the frozen VLA's predicted

translated_title: 检索以行动：面向鲁棒视觉-语言-动作执行的运动基元图检索
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略展现出卓越的语义泛化能力，但在执行过程中仍然极易受到分布外（OOD）视觉变化的影响。虽然现有的测试时方法试图抑制虚假的视觉线索，但它们从根本上忽略了策略自身训练经验中蕴含的丰富的、未受破坏的运动学先验。我们提出了“检索以行动”，这是一个测试时扩展框架，它将OOD鲁棒性纯粹地表述为一个几何运动基元检索问题。R2A通过将成功的训练演示组织成离线的时空运动基元图，从而绕过脆弱的视觉特征。在推理过程中，一个依赖于查询的图神经网络在该图中动态定位机器人正在进行的执行状态，检索出结构上兼容的未来运动基元。随后，这些检索到的几何先验与冻结的VLA模型的预测无缝融合。
tldr: 本文提出R2A测试时扩展框架，通过将成功训练演示构建为时空运动基元图，并利用查询依赖的图神经网络在图中检索结构兼容的未来运动基元，将其几何先验与冻结的VLA预测融合，从而有效提升VLA策略在分布外视觉变化下的执行鲁棒性。
